objective: Attribute (or fail to attribute) the 0.55-0.68% residual F-099 measured between tick_volume and len(copy_ticks_range). Pre-registered 9-candidate frozen list with an anti-overfit clause, discovery capture, then an independent holdout capture from a separate session. Outcome: UNATTRIBUTED (V1) and UNATTRIBUTED_V2 -- a perfect 4/4 discovery pattern failed out-of-sample. Records the previously-untracked Phase 0 tick-class observation and the newly-discovered non-stationarity of MT5's tick flag vocabulary.
change_class_rationale: Evidence probe bearing on OHLCV BC-4 / BC-5 for the admitted dataset's producer family. Research-only: no admission-gate change, no schema change, no dataset-record edit. Additive module + tests + evidence artifacts + doc updates.
anti_overfit_discipline: The 9-candidate list was frozen in the user-approved plan BEFORE any raw tick array existed. When all 9 failed, the pattern spotted in discovery output (count(flags & TICK_FLAG_BID)) was registered as a HYPOTHESIS with zero out-of-sample support -- appended to the prereg as section 8 BEFORE the holdout was scored -- and tested separately as V2, never retro-fitted into V1. C9_flag_bid is deliberately excluded from the V1 CANDIDATES dict so V1's UNATTRIBUTED outcome stays byte-reproducible; pinned by test_v2_candidate_is_not_in_the_v1_frozen_list.

unknowns.question: What actually explains the 0.55-0.68% residual, now that tick class, boundary inclusion, duplication, price-change filtering and BID-flag filtering are all ruled out?
unknowns.resolution: UNRESOLVED and explicitly not searched further -- prereg section 8.3 forbids a third candidate search off the same data. The residual is better characterised than before but unexplained.
unknowns.followup: A future attempt needs a genuinely new pre-registration and must treat the tick flag vocabulary as non-stationary across sessions (the mechanism that broke V2).

unknowns.question: Why the tick flag vocabulary changed between the 2026-09-02 late session and the 2026-09-03 morning session.
unknowns.resolution: Observed and recorded, not explained. Discovery bars carried {134,130,4}; holdout bars {6,2,4}; the failing 07:00 bar carried both.
unknowns.followup: Out of scope for this program; recorded as a risk surface for any flag-based rule.
